96: /// Keeps track of all voting rounds (block numbers) within a session.
97: /// Only round numbers > `best_done` are of interest, all others are considered stale.
98: ///
99: /// Does not do any validation on votes or signatures, layers above need to handle that (gossip).
100: #[derive(Debug, Decode, Encode, PartialEq)]
101: pub(crate) struct Rounds<B: Block, AuthorityId: AuthorityIdBound> {
102: 	rounds: BTreeMap<Commitment<NumberFor<B>>, RoundTracker<AuthorityId>>,
103: 	previous_votes: BTreeMap<
104: 		(AuthorityId, NumberFor<B>),
105: 		VoteMessage<NumberFor<B>, AuthorityId, <AuthorityId as RuntimeAppPublic>::Signature>,
106: 	>,
107: 	session_start: NumberFor<B>,
108: 	validator_set: ValidatorSet<AuthorityId>,
109: 	voting_weights: BTreeMap<AuthorityId, VoteWeight>,
110: 	mandatory_done: bool,
111: 	best_done: Option<NumberFor<B>>,
112: }
113: 
114: impl<B, AuthorityId> Rounds<B, AuthorityId>
115: where
116: 	B: Block,
117: 	AuthorityId: AuthorityIdBound,
118: {
119: 	pub(crate) fn new(
120: 		session_start: NumberFor<B>,
121: 		validator_set: ValidatorSet<AuthorityId>,
122: 	) -> Self {
123: 		let voting_weights =
124: 			validator_set.validators().iter().fold(BTreeMap::new(), |mut acc, authority| {
125: 				*acc.entry(authority.to_owned()).or_insert(0) += 1;
126: 				acc
127: 			});
128: 
129: 		Rounds {
130: 			rounds: BTreeMap::new(),
131: 			previous_votes: BTreeMap::new(),
132: 			session_start,
133: 			voting_weights,
134: 			validator_set,
135: 			mandatory_done: false,
136: 			best_done: None,
137: 		}
138: 	}
